record.field: Search customers or vendors by name, email, tax id or reference. ALWAYS use it to get the partner id before creating an order. If several partners match, ask the user which one. Never invent an id.
Search products by name, internal reference or barcode. ALWAYS use it to get the product id before adding a line. If several products match, ask the user which one. Never invent an id.
Read a sales order or quotation with its lines (line ids are needed to change a line).
Create an EMPTY draft quotation for a customer. Afterwards add each product with the 'Add Quotation Line' tool. Call it once per quotation. The quotation is only a draft: a person must confirm it.
Change the reference, note or validity date of a DRAFT quotation. Only the values you provide are changed.
Add ONE product line to a DRAFT quotation. Call it once per product. Leave the price empty to use the pricelist price; only set it when the user gives a price.
Change the quantity, unit price or discount of a line of a DRAFT quotation. Use the line_id returned by 'Get Order'. To remove a line tell the user a person must delete it.
Read a purchase order or request for quotation with its lines (line ids are needed to change a line).
Create an EMPTY draft request for quotation for a vendor. Afterwards add each product with the 'Add RFQ Line' tool. Call it once per request. The RFQ is only a draft: a person must confirm it.
Change the vendor reference, note or expected date of a DRAFT request for quotation. Only the values you provide are changed.
Add ONE product line to a DRAFT request for quotation. Call it once per product. Leave the price empty to use the vendor price list; only set it when the user gives a price.
Change the quantity or unit price of a line of a DRAFT request for quotation. Use the line_id returned by 'Get Order'. To remove a line tell the user a person must delete it.
